title: The Lead and the teams live after the review fixes: three rounds until nothing new
request: The owner: fix the review bugs, run the live test after the fixes, and if more bugs appear fix them and run it again, continuously.
spec: Live scenarios S1-S11 on the configured open model (Qwen on OpenRouter, never Claude) and on the rules, each in its own workspace under agent_runs/live_tests/2026-11-22-lead-*; graded from the draft's messages and the team records, never the model's words about itself.
plan: round 1 on the fixed code with two new scenarios (S9 refusal, S10 phone-service question)
independent review of the fixes in parallel
fix the review's findings, gate, commit
round 2 on the committed code, plus live_lead_teams.py
round 3 for the one fix not yet seen live (S11 comma order)

decisions.decision: Write each review trigger as a live scenario (S9 refusal, S10 phone-service question, S11 comma order)
decisions.why: a fix is believed only once the real model and the real app show it, not only a unit test

decisions.decision: Grade each scenario by hand against its expectation, fixed before the run, from the chat and the team records
decisions.why: the script records observations; the model's words about itself are never the measure

change: scripts/live_lead_scenarios.py: S9, S10, S11; the own-words measure compares without letter case.

findings.defect: own_words was false whenever the model passed the request without its 'Please ask the teams:' prefix
findings.scenario: round 2 S5, S6 and round 3 S11 on Qwen: the task's question was the person's request with a capital first letter
findings.cause: the check compared with letter case
findings.fix: compare case-insensitively; 7 of 7 handed requests carry the person's words
findings.test: rerun of the measure on the kept round 2 and 3 results

findings.defect: Home's model promised 'the ranked list will come back' though the teams report feasibility, not a ranking
findings.cause: model wording in its hand-over message (prompt territory)
findings.fix: not fixed: a prompt change needs make agent-eval and the harness eval; left for the owner

outcome: No new product bug in rounds 2 and 3; one measurement bug fixed, one wording issue left for a prompt change.
lessons: Write the review's trigger as a live scenario, so the fix is seen with the real model and not only in a unit test.
A measure that compares text exactly will call a faithful paraphrase a failure; check the failing rows before calling it a product bug.
risks: The scenarios were written by the agent that built and fixed the code, and each ran once; the multi-team join is seen live only in S8.
The Lead and the teams are rules with fixture specialists: the live part is Home's model deciding to hand over.
